comparability: Same seed, rows, masks, folds, fixed losses, propensity probabilities and ridge coefficients; only held-out Ipc values vary in the stability sensitivity.
manuscript_takeaway: A single unobserved held-out compound with extreme Ipc extrapolation dominates the selected seed's high-dimensional AIPW risk. A dense independent ridge solve retains the anomaly, while clipping that feature to the training range removes the catastrophic scale but does not establish general estimator validity.
failure_interpretation: Configuration-specific descriptor extrapolation; evidence does not support a general high-dimensional representation failure claim.
limitations: Post-result diagnostic of one existing replay seed, not a new confirmation or all-seed refit.
Fresh LSQR model fits are numerically close but not bitwise identical to stored fits; their floating-point difference is not fully isolated.
The oracle rows repeat across propensity representations and are not independent evidence.
A stable numerical scale is not proof of unbiasedness, transportability, or identification.
